title: Rising Up to Claim the Land
description: Join Pastor Chris Zehner as he prays for a supernatural breakthrough and expansion of The River Church of Kansas City, believing that God is calling them to take the land, overcome Giants, and reach thousands of souls with the Gospel. In this powerful sermon, Pastor Zehner calls out for a fresh wave of revival, empowerment, and funding to reach all nations, and challenges the church to dream big and believe in the impossible. As you listen, be inspired to join the movement of faith and see the impact that a church empowered by God can have on the world.
